notes.title: Quick Bug Fix
notes.content:
Thanks to Slayne for letting us know about an upgrade bug in MonGirlTile :) I spent the morning tracking it down along with making a few small fixes (including making the cheat button harder to activate on accident ;) )

Thanks to everyone for supporting us! This has been both fun and super educational.
